newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia sells HRK111 mln 42-day T-bills, rate down.
newsitem.headline: Croatia sells HRK111 mln 42-day T-bills, rate down.

text.p: Croatia's finance ministry raised 111 million kuna of a planned 120 million through 42-day treasury bills at an auction on Tuesday.
The issue was priced higher at 98.834 percent with a single interest rate of 10.25 percent, down from 10.5 two weeks ago.
Bills are payable in two days and they mature on April 17.
The banking sector bought 94.5 percent of the issue, the ministry said in a statement.
It set the next auction for March 18, when 40 million kuna worth of 91-day T-bills will be offered to investors.
Foreigners have no direct access to bill sales but they can place their bid through Croatian banks. -- Davor Huic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
